activity_summary: You wrote four lines and no name over them, no number, and no title. They begin How oft when thou my musike musike playst. You did not set a name on the leaf, and you did not speak the lines in the room where she played.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the four lines and did not sign them.
